title: GEMglMatrixMode
description: specify which matrix is the current matrix

messages.description: which matrix stack is the target for subsequent matrix operations

arguments.description: which matrix stack is the target for subsequent matrix operations

body: [GEMglMatrixMode] calls glMatrixMode() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Its creation arguments also take GL constants by name; its inlets only take their values. See glMatrixMode in the OpenGL reference.
